tests.title: PB-ABR-002 downshifts when bandwidth drops mid-playback (bandwidth-drop): at most one rebuffer, settles on a rung the network can carry
PB-ENV-001 the engine plays the selected flavour through the player, or the engine and OS pair is a documented gap
PB-LIVE-001 joins near the live edge: first frame, and latency at the first frame within the p95 limit
PB-LIVE-002 latency stays bounded over a 20 s window: maximum within the limit, no live-edge seek loop, no rebuffer
PB-LIVE-003 manifest refresh keeps the playhead inside the seek range across at least five refreshes
PB-LIVE-004 HLS live: joins, plays and stays inside the sliding window across at least five playlist refreshes
PB-REC-008 live origin stall: the player resumes after the origin returns, with at most one stall episode and no critical error left
PB-REC-001 transient segment 404: the failed request is retried and succeeds, playback continues with no critical error and at most one rebuffer
PB-REC-002 5xx burst on one segment: playback continues by retry or rung switch, with no critical error and at most one rebuffer
PB-VOD-012 metrics integrity on a clean network: decoded frames above zero, dropped no more than decoded, presented frames agree with decoded, no rebuffer, startup defined, no error
PB-VOD-006 seek forward inside the buffered range: seeked fires and playback continues from the target with no rebuffer
PB-VOD-007 seek to an unbuffered position: seeked, playback from the target, and the request log shows the segment that covers it and no refetch of earlier ones
PB-VOD-009 rapid repeated seeks: five seeks issued back to back, the last target wins, playback resumes, no error
